description: A socket accept that closes before sending a request currently flips the daemon to warm and refreshes idle activity. Cold/warm and idle accounting should reflect successfully served requests, not stray connects.

notes.author: darin@book
notes.content: Audit: verified in /Users/darin/Projects/raql on jj change 1902740de17e. Daemon warm/idle accounting now advances only for served requests; connect-and-close before a request no longer marks the daemon warm or refreshes idle activity. Verification: cargo test -p raql-daemon && cargo test -p raql-host-ra && cargo test --test cli_daemon_cutover -- --nocapture && cargo test --test cli_strict_runtime -- --nocapture.

title: Advance daemon warm and idle state only for served requests
